objective: Clarify monthly QMP reset while keeping lifetime QMP history and non-withdrawable revenue estimates separate and truthful.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Android Production OTA workflow run 41291297116 completed successfully from source SHA 5d8214355a8a5ea12ecfd5c0c1e520fe4e263944 on 2026-11-01. DEV main at a35596d54dc121aca7242fd5452d8100326f14ab is two commits ahead of that published source; this PR is based on that exact DEV main and changes only the contribution-card explanatory copy.
chosenApproach: Keep monthly value sourced from data.this_month_qmp and lifetime value from the separate read-only loadMyCommunityQmpHistory result; explain that prior months do not carry share weight into the current period.
alternativeApproaches: Reset or rewrite lifetime QMP values (rejected: destroys historical contribution totals).
Change server-side QMP calculations (rejected: this request is display clarification only).
selectionRationale: The confusing labels and missing explanation caused a monthly 0 display to be mistaken for loss of lifetime QMP. A copy-only clarification preserves all authoritative calculations and financial controls.
preserveBehaviors: Monthly QMP remains sourced from the current period only.
Lifetime QMP remains sourced from the separate history read.
No finance mutation, payout, wallet, or QMP calculation changes.
Revenue estimate remains provisional and non-withdrawable.
No changes to Community Posting, IGPAT, or Media Engine.
acceptanceChecks: Monthly QMP and lifetime QMP remain separate values.
Prior-month share weight is not carried into current period.
Revenue estimate remains non-withdrawable and no-safe-estimate state remains truthful.
